apiKey_help: Optional. Only needed if Moonraker authentication is enabled.
crealityWsPort_help: Default 9999. Used for toolhead LED, pause/resume/stop, leveling / self-test status and printLeftTime.
enableCfs_help: Create CFS channel, slot states (T1A–T1D) and CFS box LED.
enableControl_help: Create control states: toolhead LED, pause, resume, stop.
host_help: IP address or hostname of the Creality printer (e.g. SPARKX i7).
moonrakerPort_help: Default 7125. Fluidd reverse proxy often uses 4408.
pollInterval_help: How often Moonraker is queried. Minimum 2 seconds.
